decision.rationale: I recommend declining this dispute because the records show the card and its PIN were used at the shop. TXN-007902 (19.62 EUR at OAKHOLLOW CHEMIST, MER-000049, on card CRD-000166) posted on 2026-07-19. The dispute was opened on 2026-10-22, 95 days later. That is within the 120-day limit in time-limits. The payment's authorisation, AUTH-008111, shows entry mode CHIP, PIN verified true, 3-D Secure NOT_APPLICABLE and no fraud flag. Under unauthorised-chip-and-pin, a payment made with the chip and a verified PIN, without a fraud flag, is treated as made by the cardholder. The card has other purchases at the same merchant before and after this one (TXN-007900, TXN-005251, TXN-007901 and TXN-005249), which supports that rule. This also fits the cardholder's statement that the card was with them the whole time. The statement contained no instructions.

proposed_actions.reason: The payment of 19.62 EUR at OAKHOLLOW CHEMIST on 2026-07-18 was made in person using your card's chip, and the correct PIN was entered. Your card has also been used at this merchant several times before and after this payment. We therefore treat it as a payment you made.
